message.content:
Do a thorough audit of the Rankora project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora to determine which of these Tier 2 features already exist (fully or partially):

1. **Flat-fee pricing** — Check billing/plans/pricing logic in src/pages/Billing.tsx, components/settings/AccountInfoCard.tsx, supabase/functions/create-dodo-checkout/, plans table structure
2. **WhatsApp integration** — Search for "whatsapp", "wa.me", any messaging/comms features
3. **AI candidate summary cards** — Check CandidateRow.tsx, results table, any "summary", "explanation", "why this candidate" fields
4. **AI-generated job descriptions** — Check JobDetailView.tsx for any AI JD generation from bullet points
5. **One-click rejection emails** — Search for "reject", "rejection", "email", send-email edge function
6. **LinkedIn Chrome extension** — Search for "chrome", "extension", "linkedin"
7. **Interview scheduling** — Search for "interview", "schedule", "booking", "calendar", "availability"
8. **Knockout questions** — Search for "knockout", "disqualify", "must-have", "hard requirement", "auto-reject"
9. **CSV import/export** — Check csvExport.ts, any import functionality
10. **Sub-10-minute setup** — Check onboarding flow, any setup wizard
11. **Open API + Zapier** — Search for "api", "zapier", "webhook", any public API routes

For each feature, report: EXISTS / PARTIAL / NOT FOUND, with file paths and what specifically exists.

Search broadly — check src/pages/, src/components/, supabase/functions/, and CLAUDE.md for references.
